title: Equilibrium length
description: Essential: Correctly states the spring length at equilibrium as L + (mg sin α)/k.

title: Maximum elongation
description: Essential: Correctly states the maximum elongation as L/4 + (2mg sin α)/k.

title: Friction condition
description: Essential: Correctly states the condition for the inclined plane to remain stationary as μ ≥ ((kL + 4mg sin α) cos α) / (4Mg + 4mg cos² α - kL sin α).

title: Equilibrium force balance
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law to the block along the incline to find the equilibrium extension.

title: SHM amplitude calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the amplitude of oscillation from the initial compression and equilibrium position.

title: Incline force analysis
description: Important: Sets up force balance equations (horizontal and vertical) for the inclined plane, identifying the spring force and normal forces.

title: Maximum static friction
description: Important: Applies the condition for impending motion, relating the required static friction to the maximum available (μ * N).

title: Sign error in spring force
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the spring force (compression vs. extension) in the force balance equations.

title: Missing normal force component
description: Pitfall: Omits the vertical component of the spring force when calculating the normal force from the ground (FN2).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Verifies dimensional consistency of the final expressions for length and the friction condition.
